rejected_rule.statement: A discrepancy between the description of the land surveyed and depicted in the preliminary plan and the description of the land set out in the schedule to the plaint shall not by itself affect the plaintiff's right to maintain the action.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In fact, points of contest nos. 5 and 6 proposed by the 1st Defendant clearly suggests that the corpus consists of the four lots depicted in Plan No. 338 (Y). For the foregoing reasons, I hold that it is not open to the 1st Defendant now to claim that a larger portion of land should form the corpus sought to be partitioned.
